description: This file defines the EmployeeEducation entity class for the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties such as employee, education, institute, major, year, score, start and end dates, along with their respective getters and setters. The class maps to the 'ohrm_emp_education' database table and uses Doctrine ORM annotations for ORM configuration.

classes.name: EmployeeEducation
classes.description: Represents an employee's education record, including related employee and education details, as well as education-specific information like institute, major, year, score, start date, and end date.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the EmployeeEducation record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the EmployeeEducation record.

methods.name: getEducation
methods.description: Returns the Education entity associated with this employee education record.

methods.name: setEducation
methods.description: Associates an Education entity with this employee education record.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee entity associated with this education record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with this education record.

methods.name: getInstitute
methods.description: Returns the institute where the education was obtained.

methods.name: setInstitute
methods.description: Sets the institute where the education was obtained.

methods.name: getMajor
methods.description: Returns the major field of study.

methods.name: setMajor
methods.description: Sets the major field of study.

methods.name: getYear
methods.description: Returns the year of graduation or completion.

methods.name: setYear
methods.description: Sets the year of graduation or completion.

methods.name: getScore
methods.description: Returns the score or grade achieved.

methods.name: setScore
methods.description: Sets the score or grade achieved.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the education period.

methods.name: setStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the education period.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the education period.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the education period.
